routes.name: Short-Stay Visa (tourism, business, mission, internship, medical, research, NGO)
routes.summary: Short visa for 30, 60 or 90 days. It can't be converted into a long-stay visa. Madagascar also runs an official eVisa portal at evisamada.gov.mg, but it blocks bots so eVisa details were not confirmed.

other: Passport valid more than 6 months past return date, 2 blank pages
Tourism: accommodation proof. Business: invitation letter from a Malagasy company
Embassy page lists no visa exemptions. Check evisamada.gov.mg for eVisa and visa on arrival rules
Embassy page shows a second set of fees (EUR 20, 25, 35), so confirm the fee with the embassy

stay.note: 30, 60 or 90 days. Not convertible to long stay.

sources.label: Madagascar Embassy Brussels, short stay visa
